name: Mizukami
source:
Junior high school student and active fraudster.

Although he is enrolled in a school in the capital, he has rarely been seen. He was recruited by Shironeko to become a Savant candidate, but after his disappearance, he began investigating the organization on his own.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#miz]official website[/url]]
